The source text, verbatim:

# Advisor portal landing page

## Business objective
Give MapleSure advisors a single, clear entry page for the Advisor Portal so that an advisor can reach secure sign-in, find the client servicing journeys they use most (policy lookup, claim status, commission statements) and reach advisor support in under one minute, without calling the MapleSure advisor service desk.

## Background
Today advisors land directly on the secure sign-in screen with no guidance. Advisor service desk logs show that "where do I check a claim" and "where are my commission statements" are the two most common advisor calls. A small, focused landing page is expected to remove most of them.

## Requirements
1. The landing page is served at the portal root ("/") for signed-out and signed-in advisors, with the MapleSure brand header and footer.
2. A hero section states what the Advisor Portal does in one sentence and shows a primary call to action "Sign in securely" that opens the existing secure sign-in flow.
3. Three quick-link tiles open the existing policy lookup, claim status and commission statement pages; each tile requires sign-in first if the advisor is signed out.
4. A "How it works" strip shows the three steps: sign in with your advisor code, choose a servicing journey, track the outcome.
5. A support panel shows the advisor service line hours and a link to the advisor help centre; hours and the help-centre URL are read from the existing portal configuration, never hard-coded.
6. The page meets WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard reachable calls to action, visible focus, colour contrast of at least 4.5:1, and images with alternative text.
7. The page is responsive and usable on a 360px wide mobile viewport as well as desktop.
8. Page views and click-through on each call to action are recorded as analytics events without any advisor, client or policy identifiers in the payload.

## Out of scope
Changes to the secure sign-in flow itself, the policy, claim or commission pages, or client-facing pages.
